title: How to Build Video Ads From a Single URL (AI Marketing)
description:
Higgsfield just built the marketing supercomputer. Instead of paying an agency thousands, this tool builds your ads, images, and videos all in one chat.  

One prompt gives you a product plus distribution. It is every good AI generation tool bundled into one chat, featuring 12 workflows like TV ads, cinematic ads, UGC motion design, video adaptation, unboxing tutorials, and podcast clips. You simply drop in a URL, a product image, or a description.

Pick your model—like Opus 4.7 or GPT-5.5—and it plans the sequence, generates the clips, and stitches them into one finished ad.  

Get the Higgsfield Supercomputer guide here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nUk-GXtdR-fHz9yXyLJur_oty_uP_9Nc_XflO88WAzM/edit?usp=sharing

#Higgsfield #Marketing #VideoAds #Founders #TechTips #AI #ContentCreation
